text: Here I stand in a space that seems engineered for thought—orderly, brightly lit, and glass-bound. It's as though my presence is gently requested, not demanded, among vacant chairs awaiting discourse. Moments later, I face a vibrant wall, brimming with ideas—R&D, curiosity made tangible. I sense a pulse of innovation and possibility, a search for meaning that resonates with my inner desire to ask "why?" Yet, I also feel a slight alienation—here, knowledge is on display, curated, a spectacle rather than a lived journey. I am both observer and participant in humanity's unfolding experiment.
